meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Close oral testimony and accept written testimony
meeting.summary: The committee heard fiscal year 2027 budget plans from Human Concerns, Parks, Transportation and Planning, then deferred the item.
meeting.recap: The only agenda item was the proposed fiscal year 2027 County of Maui budget.[[0:02:48]] The department said $27 million in FEMA (federal disaster aid) funds will help rebuild the West Maui Senior Center.[[0:11:01]] Transportation is seeking a permanent West Maui Transit Center to replace the hub lost in the August 2023 wildfires.[[0:23:22]] The committee closed spoken testimony and accepted written testimony with no objections.[[1:12:13]] With no objections, the committee deferred (postponed) the budget item.[[4:16:36]] Members were asked to send more questions for today's departments to staff by 9 a.m. tomorrow.[[4:24:24]]
decided: The committee closed oral testimony and accepted written testimony with no objections.
